newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong property stocks fall on mortgage cap cut.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong property stocks fall on mortgage cap cut.

text.p: Shares of property companies fell after the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) recommended capping luxury home mortagages at 60 percent of a property's value, brokers said on Wednesday.

Property stocks led the market's fall with the Hang Seng Properties sub-index down 492.69 or 1.91 percent to 25,335.76 around midday. The blue-chip Hang Seng index fell 160.95 or 1.20 percent to 13,242.34.
Analysts said they saw no direct impact from the HKMA move but noted investors sense it may be a signal from the government to curb speculative activities in the property market.
